recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-14102 unless a future generated publication surface regresses the Task.priority summary.
issue_request: FHIR-14102 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core Task change request reporting that Task.priority listed normal | urgent | asap | stat even though the Request Priority value set code is routine, not normal.
initial_application: The issue was applied by historical commit a65352cbd0da82a126e7fc79d91ba77cdf075d9d, which changed source/task/task-spreadsheet.xml from normal | urgent | asap | stat to routine | urgent | asap | stat. Later source rework replaced the spreadsheet with source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml while preserving the corrected short description.
additional_context: Task remains active in source/fhir.ini, and source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml binds Task.priority to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-priority. The current request-priority code system defines routine, urgent, asap, and stat. Direct FHIR-14102 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence; a 2018 Connectathon Zulip hit independently noted the same R3 Task.priority normal-versus-routine rendering problem.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the build-scope current source already contains the corrected Task.priority short value and no current source occurrence of the old normal-based code list remains.
